```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)



craneo<- read_xlsx( "C:\\Users\\W10\\Desktop\\ESTADISTICA MULTIVARIADA\\ACTIVIDADES\\AVANCE_DE_PROYECTO2\\Libro1.xlsx")

craneo<- craneo %>% mutate(Tipo=as.factor(Tipo))

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

p1 <- ggplot(craneo, aes(x = Longitud, fill = Tipo)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5)
p2 <- ggplot(craneo, aes(x = Anchura, fill = Tipo)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5)
p3 <- ggplot(craneo, aes(x =Altura, fill = Tipo)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5)
p4 <- ggplot(craneo, aes(x =Altura_Cara, fill = Tipo)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5)

ggarrange(p1, p2, p3,p4, nrow = 2, common.legend = TRUE)


pairs(x = craneo[, c("Longitud","Anchura","Altura","Altura_Cara")],
      col = c("firebrick", "green3")[craneo$Tipo], pch = 19)


library(scatterplot3d)
scatterplot3d(craneo$Longitud, craneo$Anchura, craneo$Altura,
              color = c("firebrick", "green3")[craneo$Tipo], pch = 19,
              grid = TRUE, xlab = "Longitud", ylab = "Anchura",
              zlab = "Altura", angle = 65, cex.axis = 0.6)
legend("topleft",
       bty = "n", cex = 0.8,
       title = "Dos tipos de Craneo",
       c("a", "b"), fill = c("firebrick", "green3"))

scatterplot3d(craneo$Longitud, craneo$Anchura, craneo$Altura_Cara,
              color = c("firebrick", "green3")[craneo$Tipo], pch = 19,
              grid = TRUE, xlab = "Longitud", ylab = "Anchura",
              zlab = "Altura Cara", angle = 65, cex.axis = 0.6)
legend("topleft",
       bty = "n", cex = 0.8,
       title = "Dos tipos de Craneo",
       c("a", "b"), fill = c("firebrick", "green3"))



nsov1<-
craneo%>% filter(Tipo==1)%>%
  ggplot(aes(Longitud, y = ..density..)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "cornsilk", colour = "grey60", size = .2) +
  geom_density()+theme_bw()
```
